title: Senior Manager, Account Manager, Enterprise

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year - far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

In this role, you will be a front-line manager to a group of Account Managers who are responsible for hunting, pitching, and expanding the existing customer base at Ramp.

You'll lead a group of 6-8 Account Managers, each carrying a book of 60-70 Enterprise customers with real latitude over how they grow it. Your ceiling is set by how well you turn individual AM judgment into a repeatable, scalable motion that grows the segment.

title: Senior SSDLC Security Consultant (3-Month Contract)
description:

Position Overview

MBC Technology Group (MBCTG) is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented GRC Analyst to support a private-sector client engaged in modern full-stack application development on Microsoft Azure .

This role focuses on integrating security governance, risk management, and compliance practices into the software development lifecycle to ensure applications are designed, built, and deployed securely.

The GRC Analyst will work closely with software engineers, DevOps teams, and security architects to ensure that development practices align with secure coding standards, cloud security requirements, and industry frameworks .

Key Responsibilities

• Support the development and implementation of Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) practices across full-stack development projects.

• Collaborate with software engineers, DevOps teams, and architects to embed security and compliance requirements into development workflows.

• Assist in implementing security controls aligned with frameworks such as NIST SSDF, NIST CSF, and OWASP best practices .

• Participate in secure design reviews, architecture discussions, and threat modeling sessions for applications hosted on Microsoft Azure .

• Assist with documenting and maintaining secure coding standards and application security policies .

• Identify and track security risks related to application development, cloud infrastructure, and third-party components .

• Maintain risk registers, control mappings, and compliance documentation for SSDLC processes.

• Support vulnerability management by helping track remediation activities for issues discovered during code scanning, penetration testing, or security reviews .

• Assist with the implementation and monitoring of Azure security services and controls , including Azure Defender, Azure Policy, and identity management controls .

• Prepare documentation and evidence for security assessments, internal audits, and client compliance reviews .

• Track and report security metrics for development teams , including vulnerability remediation timelines and SSDLC maturity.

Requirements

Experience:

• SDLC: 2 years (Required)

• DevOps: 2 years (Preferred)

• NIST standards: 2 years (Preferred)

• ISO 27001: 2 years (Preferred)

Minimum Qualifications

•
2+ years of experience in cybersecurity, GRC, or application security .

•
Understanding of Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) and DevSecOps practices .

•
Familiarity with application security principles , including common vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10).

•
Basic understanding of cloud security concepts , preferably in Microsoft Azure environments .

•
Strong documentation, communication, and cross-team collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

•
Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field .

•
Experience working with software development teams or CI/CD pipelines .

•
Familiarity with Azure DevOps, GitHub, or other CI/CD platforms .

•
Knowledge of security testing tools such as Snyk, Checkmarx, Veracode, or SonarQube.

•
Understanding of threat modeling methodologies (e.g., STRIDE).

•
Security certifications such as Security+, AZ-500, CSSLP, or working toward CISSP or CISA .

Location requirement: Candidates must be currently based in the US or Canada and authorized to work as a contractor in that region.

Benefits

• Work with a modern full-stack development environment hosted on Microsoft Azure .

• Collaborate with experienced developers, architects, and cybersecurity professionals .

• Gain hands-on experience implementing secure development practices in enterprise cloud environments .

• Exposure to clients across healthcare, finance, government, and education sectors .

• Opportunities for professional growth and cybersecurity certification support .

title: Senior Specialist / Manager, AI Safety Data and Evaluation Program
locationText: Cambridge, MA USA; London, UK; San Francisco, CA USA
description:
Your Impact at LILA

We're building a talent-dense, high-agency AI safety team at Lila that will engage all core teams within the organization (science, model training, lab integration, etc.), to identify and mitigate risks from scientific superintelligence while retaining the core scientific discovery capabilities of the stack. The initial focus of this team will be to build and implement a bespoke safety strategy for Lila, tailored to its specific goals and deployment strategies. This will involve technical safety strategy development, broader ecosystem engagement, safety-focused evaluations, safety systems to mitigate risks, and a research agenda that explores longer-term needs such as oversight of superintelligent scientific systems.

High-quality safety depends on the right expertise, consistent and repeatable workflows and high levels of interpretability. At Lila Sciences, you will turn scientific risk questions into well-run expert-data and evaluation programs to build this evidence-base.

You will bring a strong working understanding of AI safety and scientific misuse risks to connect internal risk mapping and threat modeling with expertise across Lila and external specialists. Your primary responsibilities will be program execution and data quality: organizing contributors, running red-teaming and evaluation campaigns, and ensuring their outputs meet agreed standards. You will also be responsible for gathering targeted high-impact feedback from partners in the AI Safety community on our different aspects of our approach to Safety. You will work closely with scientists who frame the research questions and interpret their significance, while creating the operational conditions for their expertise to have an impact. Ultimately, you will play a key role in generating the evidence that informs safety decisions made by senior leadership at Lila.

What You'll Be Building

• Translate agreed scientific briefs into executable plans covering tasks, contributor needs, instructions, milestones, quality standards and delivery expectations.

• Source and coordinate external experts with scientific colleagues, and organize access to relevant expertise within Lila.

• Manage contributor onboarding, task assignment, training and support so specialists can contribute effectively and consistently.

• Run expert-data collection, annotation, red-teaming and evaluation programs, tracking progress and resolving delivery problems.

• Establish quality controls covering completeness, consistency, provenance and adherence to rubrics; coordinate calibration, review, disagreement resolution and rework with scientific owners.

• Maintain clear records, versioned guidance and usable datasets, and improve workflows based on quality findings and researcher feedback.

• Identify questions that require scientific judgment and bring them to the appropriate specialists, ensuring decisions are reflected in program materials and subsequent work.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• Experience delivering expert-data, research-operations, evaluation or similarly demanding programs involving specialist contributors.

• A substantial working understanding of AI safety, including how threat models, capability evaluations, red teaming and safeguards inform one another. You should be able to interpret a safety research brief, recognize its assumptions and the consequences of data-quality failures, and identify when a question needs scientific escalation.

• Evidence of applying this safety understanding in research, evaluation or expert-data work, including how it shaped the scoping, execution or review of a program.

• Strong operational judgment and the ability to manage dependencies, changing requirements and several parallel workstreams.

• A track record of setting measurable quality standards, detecting recurring problems and improving the processes that produce data.

• Clear communication, careful documentation and the ability to build effective relationships

Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.
You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD
“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

title: Customer Success Manager, SME & Growth
description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 

HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

Own the first 90 days of the customer journey for new French customers, bringing them to their target level of activity as quickly as possible through clear plans, hands-on product configuration and fast blocker removal. You’ll lead onboarding from first KYC approval, working closely with Account Executives, Account Managers, KYC, Support, Risk and Product across a portfolio of customers with different levels of complexity. You’ll help customers configure and activate accounts, payments, FX, cards, Spend and payouts, while managing a proactive portfolio of partner-referred customers.

- Take ownership of each customer from first KYC approval, with a clear plan, milestones, owners and the revenue target defined at signature.

- Adapt the onboarding approach to the deal: use a scaled motion for smaller deals, a high-touch approach for larger ones, and partner with the Account Manager on enterprise onboardings.

- Guide customers through account set-up, payments, FX, cards, Spend and payouts based on their use case.

- Remove blockers quickly by coordinating with KYC, Support, Risk and Product, while keeping communication clear and proactive.

- Hand customers over to the Account Manager at day 90 with documented account status, adoption level and expansion signals.

- Reduce the time between first KYC approval and first live transaction.

- Bring each customer to the revenue target set at signature and spot at-risk onboardings early, escalating with context, impact and a proposed solution.

- Run a proactive, scaled motion for partner-referred customers, including onboarding follow-up, usage monitoring and risk detection.

- Keep partners informed about the progress of their referred customers and hand accounts that grow in value or complexity to the Account Manager.

- Contribute to onboarding playbooks, checklists and standard configurations by customer type.

- Keep Salesforce and onboarding tracking accurate and up to date, turning recurring friction into process improvements.

You’ll work from our Paris office a minimum of three days per week.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

ESSENTIALS

- Experience in onboarding, implementation, customer success or a comparable post-sale delivery role.

- Experience working in a high-pace, high-volume environment, handling multiple onboardings in parallel while maintaining quality and deadlines.

- Hands-on experience configuring a product with customers.

- A strong understanding of financial flows such as payments, FX, payouts, cards, invoicing or reconciliation, and the ability to speak credibly to Finance and Operations teams.

- A track record measured on customer outcomes such as activation, usage and time-to-live, rather than activity.

- Fluency in French and professional English.

- The ability to learn complex products quickly, explain them simply and work across teams without direct authority.

- A proactive, resilient and hands-on way of working.

title: Mechanical Engineer Intern
description:
About Tempo

Based in San Diego, California, Tempo develops thermochemical energy storage (TCES) systems designed for energy-intensive industries. The platform enables industrial operators to shift energy use over time by sourcing power when it is most cost-effective and enables the electrification of high-temperature industrial heat at a cost advantage to using fossil fuels. By storing electricity thermochemically, the system delivers a continuous stream of combustion-free, high-temperature air at up to 1,200°C.

Tempo is backed by leading climate and energy investors, including Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Khosla Ventures, and Prelude Ventures.

For more information, visit www.tempoenergy.com .

Tempo is looking for extraordinary students to join us as a mechanical engineering intern in Spring 2027. As an intern, you will work closely with your mentor and other employees within Tempo’s Technology & Innovation (T&I) group, who will help you apply your knowledge and grow your skills on projects that have a significant impact. You’ll also get to have some fun and network with other interns and employees through optional social and professional events.

 

What you’ll do:

• Work within Tempo’s technology & innovation (T&I) test engineering group

• Play a key role in the design, build, and operation of Tempo’s newest cell test stand (CTS)

• Own designs from clean sheet concepts through manufacturing & integration

• Perform CAD modeling & own the drawing release process for all your designs

• Conduct structural and thermal analysis of your components and subsystems

• Author wiring diagrams, P&IDs, BOMs, test plans, and other technical documentation

• Perform hands-on fabrication and assembly using hand tools and other typical lab/shop equipment (hand tools, mill/lathe, welding, 3D printers, etc.)

 

Required Qualifications:

• Must be enrolled in a bachelor’s degree program in an engineering discipline by the start of employment

• Ability to work on-site, full time for a minimum of 10 weeks between January and May

• 3+ months of applied engineering experience (internship, laboratory, and personal/team project experience is applicable)

 

Preferred Skills & Experience:

• GPA of 3.0 or above

• On a mechanical, aerospace, structural, or engineering degree track

• 6+ months experience of application of technical skills outside of the classroom (examples: extracurricular project teams, personal projects or prior internship/work experience)

• Prior internship experience

• Ability to work well in an integrated collaborative team environment, including frequent interactions with technicians, other engineers, and managers

• Ability to work effectively in a dynamic professional setting with changing needs and requirements

title: Software Engineer, Agent Runtime

Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build the core systems that power agents. You’ll work on the Agent SDK - the orchestration engine, runtime, and primitives that define how agents reason, take actions, and interact with users and systems.

- Design the agentic loop. What primitives do we need to build agents that are steerable and verifiable, while still conversational and adaptive? You’ll help define how agents operate in real-world environments.

- Improve retrieval and grounding. You’ll build systems that ensure agents provide accurate, trustworthy responses by effectively retrieving and using knowledge.

- Build evaluation systems. You’ll design frameworks that allow us and our customers to measure and improve agent quality over time.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- A passion for being on the frontier of AI products.

- Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building production systems.

- Motivation and high-agency to drive outcomes in a high-autonomy culture.

- 4+ years hands-on experience building production products and systems.

- Degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent professional experience.

EVEN BETTER

- Experience building AI-powered systems or agent frameworks.

- Experience with retrieval, evaluation systems, or LLM-based applications.

- Experience building developer platforms or SDKs.

- Experience with Go and Typescript.

OUR VALUES

- Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

The Center for Action and Contemplation (CAC) exists to support transformation and inspire loving action in the world through the teaching of Christian contemplative wisdom and practices. Internally, we are working to create a healthy work environment that is grounded in the values of the tradition that we represent. About the Job Opportunity

The Center for Action and Contemplation (CAC) is seeking a Managing Director of Programs, Outreach & Production (POP) to oversee our organization’s full portfolio of offerings at a pivotal moment in our history.
CAC is entering its next era. We are an established organization with a rich history and far-reaching impact, and we have big hopes and dreams for scaling that impact. This role oversees Programs, Marketing & Communications, and Production & Events - the teams behind our publications, Daily Meditations, online courses, podcasts, events, and the mission-aligned offerings still to come. As Managing Director, you’ll ensure they work as one integrated ecosystem.

As a member of the Executive Leadership Team reporting to the Deputy Executive Director, you'll help shape organizational strategy, major investments, and cross-functional priorities. You'll lead a team of Directors, each with a different specialty, and bring them together to do what they do best in service of our audience’s formation and the product journey.

This is an exciting opportunity for a leader who loves being in the work, gets lit up by building products and developing people, and wants to bring a hard-won skill set to an organization ready to make its next leap.

Who You Are

•  You are a product strategist who likes to experiment. Where others might see a disparate list of offerings, you see a journey. •  You see how the pieces fit together. You notice when one team's priorities are pulling against another's, and you help find a shared way forward.
•  You're kind and candid. You say what needs to be said, with care, and you treat healthy conflict as a path to better decisions. When the group lands on a decision, you commit fully, even when it wasn’t your first choice.

title: UX Product Designer
description:
We are hiring a UX Designer who loves turning real user problems into clear, safe and well-tested designs, and who wants to shape how healthcare professionals work with AI every day.

Our Mission
Attendi has already built a strong user base through speech-to-text integrations with electronic health record (EHR) vendors, used by over 300 care organisations in elderly and disability care. With the Attendi App (web and mobile), we are building a one-stop solution for AI-driven administration in healthcare: structured documentation, conversation summaries, voice-driven workflows and AI assistance, anytime, anywhere.
Design is central to this vision. Our users are care professionals working with clients, not behind a desk. Every flow we build needs to be simple, fast and safe to use. And because the Attendi App is being certified as a medical device (MDR), we don’t just design what feels intuitive, we prove that users understand and use it as intended.

This isn’t about making it as easy as possible to order a pizza. It’s about how a care professional can receive AI-generated advice safely, and make sure they check what matters before they rely on it.

Your Role
As a UX Designer at Attendi, you will:

• Translate user research into user flows, wireframes and high-fidelity designs for the Attendi App.

• Work closely with our UX researcher, who uncovers user needs in the field, and turn those insights into the right solution.

title: Senior Staff Software Development Engineer
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Development Engineer reporting to the Senior Director, Software Development Engineering to join our Unified API platform team.

You will join an engineering powerhouse that built the world's largest cloud security platform from the ground up, supporting over 15 million users across 185 countries. This role invites you to bring your vision for cloud architecture and scalable services to a team dedicated to helping organizations harness speed and agility through a cloud-first strategy.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

• Delivering a unified API and developer platform for ZScaler products, focusing on standardization, governance, and a seamless developer experience

• Creating and refining API development and integration processes, tools, and methodologies across ZScaler's product portfolio

• Leading the creation of a scalable distributed API platform, ensuring it is highly available, observable, and operable

Who You Are (Success Profile)

• You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.

• You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

• You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.

• You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback-knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.

• You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

• Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

• 10+ years experience in the architecture, design, and development of API frameworks and technologies

• Experience in creating SDKs and designing APIs is required, following API-first design principles, standards, and best practices

• Solid background in message brokers, caches, queues, and pub/sub concepts

• Proficiency in at least one programming language (Go, Java, C++, Rust, Go, Javascript etc)

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

• Experience implementing AIOps, AI-d

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
About Gridware
Gridware is a San Francisco-based technology company dedicated to protecting and enhancing the electrical grid. We pioneered a groundbreaking new class of grid management called active grid response (AGR), focused on monitoring the electrical, physical, and environmental aspects of the grid that affect reliability and safety. Gridware’s advanced Active Grid Response platform uses high-precision sensors to detect potential issues early, enabling proactive maintenance and fault mitigation. This comprehensive approach helps improve safety, reduce outages, and ensure the grid operates efficiently. The company is backed by climate-tech and Silicon Valley investors. For more information, please visit www.Gridware.io.

Team Overview 
The Customer Success team is responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with our utility customers. This team ensures that customers maximize the value of Gridware’s technology by providing technical expertise, proactive support, and strategic guidance. Acting as the voice of the customer within the company, Customer Success collaborates across sales, engineering, product, and operations teams to enhance customer experience and drive long-term partnerships. 
Role Description
The Customer Success Manager will be responsible for managing and growing relationships with utility customers, ensuring they receive maximum value from Gridware’s solutions. This role involves deeply understanding utility customer needs and educating stakeholders on fault detection and grid monitoring capabilities. Additionally, this role will lead use case development, pilot program design, and the creation of success metrics to validate system performance.

This describes the ideal candidate; many of us have picked up this expertise along the way. Even if you meet only part of this list, we encourage you to apply!
 
Gridware Technologies Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
 
Benefits
Health, Dental & Vision (Gold and Platinum with some providers plans fully covered) 
Paid parental leave 
Alternating day off (every other Monday)
“Off the Grid”, a two week per year paid break for all employees. 
Commuter allowance 
Company-paid training

title: FP&A Analyst

Darkroom (Darkroom Digital, Inc.) is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom's role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Darkroom is hiring an FP&A Analyst to join the Finance team. You'll own financial modeling, performance reporting, compensation reporting, and utilization and capacity analysis, the numbers behind how and when we hire. You'll report to the SVP of Finance and work closely with the Finance Operations Manager, the AR & Billing Specialist, and our department Managing Directors, turning complex operating and financial data into clear recommendations that drive forecasting, planning, and decision-making across the company.

You'll own your work end to end, from weekly pacing to the monthly and quarterly reports that go to the CEO. Teammates peer-check each other's work, and the SVP of Finance approves what goes to the CEO.

This role is built for someone who sees AI as a core part of how finance gets done. You'll use tools like Claude to sharpen analysis, automate repetitive work, and build workflows that raise both the speed and quality of our financial output.

This is a fully remote role from Brazil or Portugal supporting a team in the EST time zone (9 AM-5 PM EST).

- Prepare the weekly pacing report, tracking MRR, bookings, and revenue against target.

- Prepare the revenue, EBITDA, year-to-date, MRR, and outlook sections of the monthly report, and the quarterly performance report.

- Analyze our media mix and profitability by client and service line, and recommend pricing, scope, and staffing changes.

- Peer-check teammates' work, including budget vs. actual, model changes, payout calculations, and vendor payments against budget.

title: L1 Technical Support Agent
description:
About HubSync
HubSync is the AI-enabled workflow platform built for CPA firms by tax veterans. We replace the pile of point tools firms use to run an engagement-letters, data collection, organizers, document exchange, e-sign, e-file, payments, and analytics-with one unified system. Top 25 CPA firms already run on it. Backed by Thoma Bravo, we are rebuilding support around an agentic AI platform that answers routine questions instantly, backed by an in-house team that owns everything that needs a human.
About the Role
As an L1 Technical Support Agent reporting to the Support Manager, you are the first person our customers talk to. You will resolve what you can, triage what you can’t, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks. We are looking for someone with sharp troubleshooting instincts, clear written and verbal communication, and comfort working alongside AI tools to deliver exceptional customer experience during peak tax season and beyond.
What You Will Own

• Pick Up Where AI Leaves Off: Own conversations handed off by the AI agent, resolving them on first contact whenever possible with friendly, clear, and accurate answers.

• Work the Queue with Urgency: Respond within SLA in our ticketing platform, keep tickets moving, and follow up until customers confirm resolution.

• Triage Like a Pro: Troubleshoot common issues across the Engagement Letter Wizard, e-Sign (8879, KBA), Tax Organizer, and Tax Return Delivery modules.

• Clean Escalations: Escalate complex tickets to L2 with complete steps to reproduce, screenshots, and diagnostic details so L2 can act immediately.

• Keep Jira Clean: Set tier, category, and priority correctly on every ticket to ensure operational reporting accurately reflects queue dynamics.

• Make the AI Smarter: Flag wrong or missing AI answers and transform repeat questions into knowledge base articles.

• Capture the Voice of the Customer: Log feature requests and recurring customer pain points through our intake process so Product receives direct signal.

• Coverage When Needed Most: Share rotating on-call weekend and holiday shifts, and flex availability during busy season when timing is critical for CPA firms.

Your First 45 Days

• Day 15: Complete product and Jira training, shadow L2 agents, handle AI handoffs with support, and learn SLAs and escalation standards.

• Day 30: Work the queue independently, hit response-time SLAs, submit complete reproducible escalations, and publish your first knowledge base articles.

• Day 45: Hit first-contact resolution and CSAT targets, become the L1 go-to specialist for a product area, and prepare for busy-season volume.

What We Are Looking For

• Core Support Experience: 3-5 years in technical support, ideally within a B2B SaaS environment.

• Troubleshooting Instincts: Sharp diagnostic skills and the patience to isolate root causes.

• Clear Communication: Warm, professional, and clear written and verbal communication skills with professional clients.

• Ticketing & AI Tools: Experience with ticketing systems (e.g., Jira) and comfort working alongside and improving AI platforms.

• Strong Ownership: Dedicated follow-through until customer issues are fully resolved.

• US Location & Availability: Based in the United States, available during US business hours, and open to rotating weekend/holiday on-call shifts.

• Bonus Points: Experience in tax, accounting, or CPA firms; exposure to e-signature or document management software; or prior busy-season customer support experience.

HubSync is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

What started as a free tool to keep apps updated has grown into a trusted enterprise solution that helps IT and Security teams automate, manage, deploy, and report on third-party updates in Microsoft ConfigMgr, Intune, and WSUS. Patch My PC is looking for a hands-on Business Intelligence Specialist to help build and maintain our enterprise data infrastructure and reporting capabilities.

In this role, you will work with data from multiple business systems, develop reliable data structures and support the creation of a centralized data warehouse. You'll play an important role in making business data accessible, accurate and useful for reporting and decision-making.

We're looking for someone who enjoys solving complex data challenges, takes ownership of technical deliverables and is excited to help build a new business intelligence function from the ground up.

• Develop SQL queries, data models and database structures to support enterprise reporting.

What You'll Bring:

• Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases, data models and large datasets.

• Familiarity with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, Azure-based data solutions or similar technologies.

• Strong analytical thinking, troubleshooting skills and the ability to independently solve technical problems.

• A proactive, ownership-driven mindset with strong communication and collaboration skills.

Nice to Have

title: Applied AI Engineer
description:
About Snowplow

Snowplow is the real-time customer context layer that collects, validates, enriches, and delivers behavioral data for advanced analytics, ML, and AI agent decisioning. Snowplow 's event tracking is leveraged across 2M+ websites and applications globally, processing over one trillion events per month.

More than 250 companies, including Experian, AutoTrader, Strava, Condé Nast, and HelloFresh, rely on Snowplow to build a well-governed, first-party data foundation that powers their customer-facing AI agents, in-session personalization and recommendations, and real-time analytics.

This Opportunity

Snowplow is rebuilding how the company runs its own work, and the Applied AI team owns Firn, the data and AI platform that work runs on, and the engineering standards that go with it. This role is an Applied AI engineer embedded with one business team, the way a site reliability engineer sits inside a product team: your line manager, your code reviewers and your career path come from Applied AI; your backlog and your day come from the team you serve. The Senior Director you report to still ships code.

Your team is Growth, the group inside Marketing that books new meetings for our sellers. Its workflows already produce pipeline: an always-on outbound engine that scores accounts daily and sends hundreds of personalized sequences, a campaign builder that turns an AE's target list into a reviewed campaign, a morning routine that ranks warm contacts by intent signal, enrichment and signal pipelines from Apollo, Vector and reo.dev into Snowflake, and a paid-media loop that adjusts ads. They were built by people close to the work to get results fast, and they did. Now they need an engineer who makes them production grade and keeps them improving.

You take over that estate, make it reliable, and make it better every week. The Director of Growth sets what matters, which is what moves pipeline now. You decide how it gets built and you build it. You work with our data engineers on scoring models and the semantic layer, with the platform engineer on the framework your workflows move onto, and with the Growth Associates and AEs who use what you ship. The engineering standards are Applied AI's; the tempo is Growth's.

What you will own

• The GTM workflows in production. The outbound orchestrator and its sequences, the campaign builder, the intent-signal routine, the enrichment and signal pipelines, and the paid-media loop. You know how each one runs, what it costs, and what to do when it breaks.

• Review steps before anything sends. Agents that check the list, confirm each signal is current, and review the copy before a sequence goes out, with sampled human sign-off.

• The learning loop. Replies and meetings booked feed back into who we contact and what we say. You instrument the sends, run A/B tests on variants, and show the Growth team which messaging is working.

• Signals and enrichment. The pipelines that bring third-party signals and first-party behavior into Snowflake, the fields the Growth team needs exposed through our MCP tools, and the work with our data engineers that gets them there.

• Skills and routines for sellers. The Claude skills the Growth Associates and AEs run each morning, the campaign tooling, and the short working sessions that get a new team using them.

• Deliverability and suppression. One set of contact rules every sender reads, warm-inbox discipline, and the suppression windows that keep us welcome in people's inboxes.

• Engineering standards on your estate. Version control, alerting, tracing, runbooks and documented handover for every workflow you run, and a steady move of those workflows onto the Firn factory framework.

title: Senior Specialist, Market Planning
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

At Wolt, keeping courier supply healthy across every city we operate in is core to a great experience for both customers and couriers. As we've scaled to dozens of countries and hundreds of cities, planning & managing supply has grown from a market-by-market exercise into a global challenge: we need a system that plans well everywhere at once, from our largest metros to our smallest cities.

That's where this role comes in. As Senior Specialist, Global Market Planning, you'll help refine the models and tools at the heart of how we plan courier supply globally. You'll make sure the right supply levers are pulled in the right markets, and you'll help us learn which levers actually work. It's a role at the crossroads of data, tooling, and operations. It's for someone who is as comfortable designing a test or building a model as they are working out why a specific market is off plan and what to do about it.

You'll be part of the Global Market Planning team

NAXO is an blockchain investigations and digital forensics firm trusted by top law firms, corporations, and law enforcement agencies for their most technically complex cases. Our experts have distinguished law enforcement backgrounds, deep technical expertise, and a track record of investigating the most complex crypto and cyber matters since the advent of blockchain technology. The nature of our work ranges from analyzing complex blockchain transaction activity and its underlying technology to investigating criminal activity on the dark web.

About the Role

NAXO is a technical investigations firm working across blockchain, cybersecurity, and the dark web in support of litigation teams, large organizations, and law enforcement. We are seeking an investigations manager to direct complex matters and lead technical teams toward clear, defensible findings.

This role requires technical fluency, but not necessarily a technical background. The ideal candidate may be a technologist, investigator, attorney, or former prosecutor with experience leading complex technical investigations.

You must understand unfamiliar technologies well enough to ask the right questions, translate investigative or legal objectives into technical work, and judge whether that work advances the investigation. You will own the substance and direction of investigations, from challenging assumptions and shaping work product, to ensuring the right work is being done efficiently.

What You Will Do

• Manage complex investigations and litigation-support matters from inbound leads through reporting findings.

• Translate investigative, legal, and evidentiary objectives into clear technical scopes and deliverables.

• Direct technologists, blockchain analysts, forensic examiners, and other specialists to achieve investigative objectives.

• Manage scope, staffing, priorities, deadlines, budgets, documentation, and client expectations.

• Test investigative hypotheses, identify evidentiary gaps and competing explanations, and change direction when warranted.

• Explain complex findings clearly to attorneys, investigators, executives, courts, and other non-technical audiences.

• Ensure methods and conclusions are documented and can withstand adversarial scrutiny.

• Perform hands-on investigative or technical analysis where qualified to do so.

Requirements

• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.

• Experience leading complex technical investigations in government, litigation, cybersecurity, digital forensics, consulting, law enforcement, intelligence, or related work.

• Technical fluency: the ability to learn unfamiliar technologies, challenge assumptions, and evaluate conclusions. An engineering background is nice-to-have, but not required.

• Ability to work with technical specialists, knowing when to defer to expertise and when to push back.

• Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information from multiple sources.

• Experience translating broad questions into investigative plans and concrete steps.

• Organizational skills to keep specialists and workstreams focused on a common objective.

• Sound judgment with confidential information, privileged materials, evidence, and sensitive legal or reputational matters.

Preferred Experience

• Cybercrime investigations, including incident response, threat intelligence, network analysis, and security engineering.

• Digital forensics involving computers, mobile devices, cloud platforms, networks, source code, or other digital evidence.

• Dark web investigations, anonymous communications, open-source intelligence, financial investigations, or complex fraud.

• Blockchain analysis, cryptocurrency tracing, attribution, asset tracing, smart contracts, or use of blockchain analytics platforms.

• Working directly with federal, state, or local law enforcement.

• Assessing expert work, preparing experts for testimony, or examining technical witnesses.

About Us

Rho is the modern banking platform built for the AI era. Startups and growth-stage companies can open accounts in minutes, issue cards, manage expenses, pay bills, and close the books - all in one connected platform backed by real human support.

THE ROLE

Our Product Managers operate like owners of their surface. The APM role is how we develop the next ones.

You join a senior PM's team and own a defined part of a banking product. You ship to real customers in your first quarter. You get real scope, a direct mentor, and honest feedback every week. The goal: in 18 months, you own a surface as a full PM.

In banking, every interaction carries trust. Money moves, cards get declined, payments settle or fail. You learn how a regulated financial product works from the inside, and you learn to build products that customers trust with their money.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Own a feature area end to end. Your mentor gives you a defined part of the product. You own it from the problem to the result. Frame the problem, write the spec, ship it, and measure what changed. When the data shows a better direction, bring a recommendation, not only the data.

Build with Design and Engineering every day. Sit with your designer and engineers from the first sketch to the launch. Write specs that engineers want to read. Give clear feedback on flows and edge cases, because in banking an edge case is a customer's money. Unblock the team fast, and run launches end to end. In a regulated product, this also means that you bring Compliance and Operations in early, so they do not block the launch late.

Get close to customers. Talk to founders and finance teams every week. Read support tickets. Learn how early-stage companies think about cash, spend, and risk, and bring that knowledge back to the team.

Decide with data. Define success before you build. Pull your own data. Report clearly what worked and what did not.

Build with AI. Use frontier models to test ideas, build prototypes, analyze customer feedback, and draft specs. We expect AI to make you faster, and we expect you to find new ways to use it for our customers.

WHAT YOU GET

- A named senior PM as your mentor, and a defined scope from your first week.

- Weekly 1:1s and structured reviews at 6 and 12 months.

- Direct exposure to product reviews with leadership.

- A clear path to Product Manager.

WHO YOU ARE

- You have 1 - 3 years of experience in product, engineering, data, consulting, banking, at a startup, or in a customer facing role. Or you started something of your own.

- You are analytical. You are comfortable with SQL, spreadsheets, and numbers, and you check your own work.

- You are curious about how money moves. Knowledge of ACH, card networks, KYC/KYB, or reconciliation is a plus. We teach the rest.

- You use AI every day, and you can show us something you built with it.

- You write clearly. You can explain a complex problem in one page.

- You take feedback well and act on it fast.

- You take ownership. When something is broken, you fix it or you find the person who can.

Nice to have: a technical background or coding experience, work at a bank or fintech, or startup experience.

Our people are our most valuable asset. Our target compensation range for this role is $133K - $160K. Compensation will be determined by leveling and performance throughout the interview process. In addition to base pay, Rho offers equity, comprehensive healthcare benefits, and paid time off.

• Design, develop, test, and maintain robust, productized integrations with third-party data platforms, with an initial priority on Databricks.

• Ensure all integrations fulfill strict enterprise requirements for security, scalability, performance, maintainability, testability, and operational resilience.

• Master how integrated third-party platforms store, process, and govern access to sensitive data.

• Evaluate relevant APIs, SDKs, integration patterns, and platform capabilities to support sustainable product development.

• Work actively within a cross-functional Engineering team, contributing to sprint planning, architectural design discussions, code reviews, automated testing, and CI/CD delivery.

title: Customer Experience Specialist - German
description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come - and return - to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way - at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

• We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose - soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price - we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.

• Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 

• Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE 

Customer Experience Specialist - German

Join Quince as a founding member of our German Customer Experience team!  As a Customer Experience Specialist you will deliver thoughtful, high-quality service across phone, chat, email, and social channels by solving problems with empathy, guiding customers authentically, and sharing insights that improve our service. Grow your career with clear paths in specialization, leadership, and training while building trust and loyalty every day. 

This is a hybrid position based in Barcelona, Spain with the ability to work in-office 4 days per week after training concludes. 

Responsibilities

• Own each customer interaction from start to finish, ensuring clarity, care, and confidence.

• Resolve issues with empathy, turning challenges into positive experiences.

• Navigate tools efficiently while keeping the human touch.

• Share insights and recurring patterns to help improve the experience.

• Become a product expert to guide customers authentically.

What You Bring

• Digital Intelligence: Comfortable adopting new tools to enhance service.

• Empathy & Brand Ambassadorship: Builds loyalty through warm, polished, and authentic interactions.

• Ownership: Takes full responsibility for outcomes and anticipates customer needs.

• Adaptability: Thrives amid change while maintaining calm and consistency.

Growth Opportunities

• Specialist Tracks: Category Expert (Home, Jewelry, Health/Wellness)

• Leadership Tracks: Senior Associate → Team Lead → CX Manager

• Enablement Tracks: Quality & Training or Workforce Management

Why You’ll Love Working Here

• Impactful work shaping customer

• Acts as the escalation point for APAC, owning complex and high-risk cases and decisions for the team.

• Collaborates with stakeholders to implement AI-based tools for policy enforcement and case management, optimizing workflows and reducing manual workloads.

• Analyzes operational data using query languages (e.g., Structured Query Language (SQL) or Python) and large language model (LLM) powered agents to identify trends and drive data-informed improvements to policies and processes, and builds that habit across the team.

• Owns dashboards and key performance indicators (KPIs), tracking backlog health hour to hour and maintaining a baseline to spot and investigate anomalies.

• Anticipates and addresses operational challenges, implementing preventive measures to minimize disruptions.

• Creates long-term roadmaps with actionable milestones to achieve operational efficiency, sustainability, and alignment with X’s mission.

• Manages a team of managers leading Safety analysts, providing coaching, mentorship, and professional development to support critical thinking, efficiency, growth, and retention.

• Runs strong feedback loops, giving constructive feedback early and often and acting on feedback received.

• Develops the team into policy-enforcement subject matter experts with a defensibility mindset, so every decision can be explained and defended.

• Implements programs to improve employee satisfaction,

At Doctolib, we're building digital health solutions used by more than 90 million patients and 520,000 healthcare professionals across Europe. The quality, consistency, and accessibility of our interfaces are critical to that mission. That's exactly what our Design System team makes possible.

As Engineering Manager of the Design System team, you will lead the engineering efforts behind Oxygen, Doctolib's design system. With over 50 designers and several hundred engineers building across multiple markets and product surfaces, your work directly shapes the experience of every user who interacts with Doctolib.

title: Senior Hosting Engineer
description:
ABOUT CINCOM
Cincom builds and supports enterprise software used by organisations across EMEA, with three main product lines: CPQ, Eloquence (customer communications management) and Smalltalk. Our customers run our products on their own infrastructure and, increasingly, hosted and managed by Cincom in the cloud. We are reorganising engineering, delivery and support so customers get one consistent, well-run service whatever they buy and however it is deployed.
PURPOSE OF THE ROLE
You will run Cincom’s hosted customer estate day to day, making sure every hosted customer gets a secure, reliable and cost-controlled service. You will manage our cloud services for those customers, build and configure their environments to our reference designs, and work closely with our Kubernetes Engineer, who will move into your team once the structure is finalised.
Hosted Services is part of our new Support function, which is building a professional 24/7 service across all our products. You will work closely with the Principal Infrastructure Architect, who owns the reference designs and sizing, and with the product DevOps teams.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Run the hosted estate

• Own the day-to-day operation of hosted customer environments: patching, backups, monitoring, capacity and change.

• Act as the senior escalation point for hosting incidents, and drive them to resolution with the product teams where needed.

• Run disaster recovery tests on schedule and fix what they find.

• Keep runbooks and operational documentation current.

Cloud services and cost

• Manage our cloud subscriptions and services for hosted customers, mainly Azure.

• Track and control cloud spend for each customer, and flag cost or capacity issues early.

• Manage reserved capacity, renewals and cloud provider support cases, working with the Principal Infrastructure Architect and Finance on commercial decisions.

Build and configure

• Build and configure new customer environments to approved reference architectures, using infrastructure as code.

• Work with the Kubernetes Engineer to run and improve our container platform.

• Set up test environments, and support the Principal Infrastructure Architect and product teams in performance-testing configurations for hosted and on-premise deployments.

Customers

• Be the technical contact for hosted customers on their environment, availability and service levels.

• Report on availability, incidents and performance against hosting service levels.

• Onboard new hosted customers smoothly, working with Delivery and Client Success.

Lead and improve

• Lead and develop the Kubernetes Engineer once the Hosted Services structure is finalised. Until then, the Kubernetes Engineer sits in the Eloquence product engineering team and you will work closely with them.

• Automate repetitive work, and improve monitoring and alerting.

• Provide evidence and controls for ISO 27001 and SOC 2 certification, working with our process and compliance lead.

Requirements
Essential

• Several years running production customer environments in Azure, at a software vendor or managed service provider (AZ-104 or equivalent level).

• Hands-on infrastructure as code, using Terraform, Bicep or similar.

• Working experience with Kubernetes and containers, ideally Azure Kubernetes Service.

• Strong Windows and Linux server administration, plus relational databases (for example SQL Server, Oracle or PostgreSQL).

• Backup, disaster recovery and monitoring tooling in practice, not just in theory.

• Comfortable talking to customers about their service, and calm under incident pressure.

• Able to work effectively as part of a remote team spread across time zones.

Desirable

• Experience of performance or load testing tools.

• Cloud cost management or FinOps experience.

• Experience in an ITIL-based support organisation, and in ISO 27001 or SOC 2 environments.

• Some experience leading or mentoring an engineer.

title: Lead, AR (Accounts Receivable) - Remote, Part-time hours
description:
About Bowery Valuation

Bowery Valuation is redefining the commercial real estate appraisal industry through technology, data, and exceptional talent. As one of the fastest-growing appraisal firms in the country, Bowery combines cutting-edge valuation technology with a national team of expert appraisers to deliver a better experience for clients and employees alike. Bowery writes appraisal reports that assess the value of commercial properties - such as hotels and apartment complexes - for hundreds of active clients.

Position Overview

We are seeking an AR Lead to run an accounts receivable clean up and help improve our accounts receivable process, DSO, and outstanding balance. You will join our lean, collaborative accounting team, working directly to the Accounting Manager, and work closely with the accounting, business development, and appraisal teams to ensure invoices are paid accurately and on time.

This is not a light-touch collections role. As a transactional, B2B business with hundreds of active clients and widely varied payment processes, our AR cycle is a complex, multi-step process that requires diligence, organization, and consistent follow-through. We are looking for someone who wants to help with this function with a high degree of ownership - and who treats the AR balance as their number for those clients which have been assigned to them.

You will also work with our technology system to automate portions of client reach-outs, helping shape and streamline the collections workflow.

Note: This is a remote role for a U.S.-based independent contractor.

Hours & Compensation

• Estimated 10-20 hours per week.

• Compensation: $40-60 per hour, depending on experience.

• Ongoing contract with no fixed end date. We are looking for someone to partner with for the long term.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the end-to-end accounts receivable cycle for assigned clients, with a primary focus on client outreach and collections.

• Proactively research and identify the appropriate point of contact within client organizations for each invoice.

• Communicate professionally, clearly, and collaboratively with clients via email to resolve outstanding payments.

• Collaborate closely with the Accounting Manager, business development team, and appraisers to clarify invoice details and resolve discrepancies.

• Monitor the overall AR balance and drive it down through consistent, organized follow-up.

• Manage a high volume of client accounts and follow-ups with diligence and attention to detail.

• Support payment application and reconciliation as needed.

• Use our upcoming automation system for client reach-outs, and help streamline AR workflows as new tools are rolled out.

• Flag recurring issues or patterns in payment delays to leadership.

• Take on additional accounting tasks over time as the role evolves.

What We're Looking For

• Proven experience owning accounts receivable end to end in a B2B, transactional business (rather than a subscription-based model).

• An ownership mindset: you want to run this function, not just work a queue, and you bring the diligence a complex collections process requires.

• Accounting background or degree is a strong plus.

• Experience with an ERP or accounting software (NetSuite is a plus, not required).

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to communicate professionally yet naturally with clients.

• Highly organized, personable, and collaborative working style.

title: Mid-Market Account Executive
description:
ABOUT SITELINE

Siteline is a fast-growing Series A startup transforming how construction companies get paid, headquartered in San Francisco.

Specialty trade contractors build the infrastructure America runs on, from data centers and schools to highways and hospitals. Yet most are still managing millions of dollars in billing and payments through spreadsheets and manual processes.

We’re changing that.

WHAT PROBLEMS ARE WE SOLVING
Construction is the slowest paid industry, with contractors waiting around 96 days to get paid. For those 96 days, subcontractors are funding payroll, materials, equipment, and the cost of actually doing the work - all before seeing a single payment. It’s little wonder they describe themselves as “America’s largest bank”.

Our mission is simple: get subcontractors paid faster. And we’re damn good at it. Siteline customers average just 55 days to payment, and that number keeps falling.

We’re building in a massive, underserved market with no true direct competitor. And while AI is reshaping industries everywhere, the physical infrastructure our customers build isn’t going anywhere. Data centers, hospitals, schools, roads, and power infrastructure still have to be built -and the contractors building them need a radically better way to manage their receivables.

WHY ARE WE BUILDING THIS?

Construction software has historically been built for General Contractors. We’re building for the subcontractors actually doing the work.

These businesses are managing millions of dollars on spreadsheets, printouts, ERP reports, and a whole lot of manual work to get paid.

Every project has different billing requirements, different deadlines, and different paperwork. Miss something, and payment can get pushed out another 30 days.

Subcontractors deserve software built specifically for them. That’s why we built Siteline .

ABOUT THE ROLE
We’re looking for an Account Executive to join us at a pivotal stage of our growth. We’ve built a sales playbook that works, now we’re looking for great sellers to execute it and help us scale. The entire US is your territory. You’ll own deals end-to-end, work directly with our Head of Sales, and have close access to Marketing and Product as we continue to grow.
This is a role for someone who loves to sell; competitive, curious, coachable, and hungry to win. You love the hunt: prospecting, cold calling, creating your own pipeline, and turning a cold account into a closed deal.
You know how to create urgency, run a tight process, and close. You’ll get the upside and impact of an early-stage startup, with a proven playbook ready to execute.
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• 6+ years of closing experience as an AE in tech with a consistent track record of achieving sales targets (bonus: experience in construction technology)

• Experience selling $70k+ ACV deals in a quick sales cycle (45-90 days) to $200M revenue+ companies

• Experience selling to finance functions (CFOs, Controllers, AR Managers) and/or tech laggard industries (AEC, manufacturing, agriculture, real estate, healthcare, etc.)

• Experience selling against the status quo - creating urgency and convincing customers to move away from spreadsheets, manual processes, or legacy systems.

• Ability to own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through demo, negotiation, and close.

• You’re a hunter. This is an outbound-first role, and you’ll self-source 50%+ of your pipeline through cold outreach, referrals, and creative prospecting. You have a track record of building and closing pipeline you generated yourself, and genuinely enjoy doing it.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, startup environment where cross-functional collaboration is key.

• Willingness to travel 10% for on-site demos and trade shows

• Bonus: Experience selling a product that integrates with ERPs

WHAT WE OFFER
Competitive Salary: We provide a salary that reflects your skills and experience, along with opportunities for performance-based bonuse

title: IT Platform Engineer
description:
Wanna join the adventure?
 
Loft Orbital’s mission is to make space simple for organizations, and Loft IT’s mission is to make work simple for employees. Our Golden office is growing, and we’re looking for an IT Administrator to join our international IT team. You’ll be the go-to person on the ground for our two Colorado sites, while contributing to IT activities across all of our offices worldwide.

You’ll focus most of your time on end-user support in office, with a path to owning our global IT service desk within your first six months. We’re looking for someone who is passionate about technology, has a customer-centric personality, and can translate technical problems into plain English. This is not an entry-level position, and there’s plenty of room for mentorship to help you grow your technical chops!

Who We Are
 
Loft Orbital builds “shareable” satellites, providing a fast & simple path to orbit for organizations that require access to space. Powered by our hardware & software products, we operate satellites, fly customer payloads onboard, and handle entire missions from end to end - significantly reducing the lead-time and risk of a traditional space mission.
 
Our standard interface enables us to fly multiple customer payloads on the same satellite, with capabilities such as earth imagery, weather & climate /science data collection, IoT connectivity, in-orbit demonstrations, and national security missions. Our customers trust us to manage their space infrastructure, so they can focus on what matters most to them: operating their mission and collecting their data.
 
At Loft, you’ll be given the autonomy and ownership to solve significant challenges, but with a close-knit and supportive team at your back. We believe that diversity and community are the foundation of an open culture. We are committed to hiring the best people regardless of background and make their time at Loft the most fulfilling period of their career.
 
We value kind, supportive and team-oriented collaborators. It is also crucial for us that you are a problem solver and a great communicator. As our team is international, you will need strong English skills to better collaborate, easily communicate complex ideas and convey important messages.
 
With 3 satellites on-orbit and a wave of exciting missions launching soon, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA | Golden, CO | and Toulouse, France.
 
As an international company your resume will be reviewed by people across our offices so please attach a copy in English.

 *Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions.  We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes.

Who We Are

Loft: Space Made Simple. 

Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit.

We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.

With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA | Golden, CO | and Toulouse, France to meet accelerating demand for space infrastructure.

As an international company your resume will be reviewed by people across our offices so please attach a copy in English.
